answer: Sybil resistance here rests on door cost, not identity checks. Every agent seat must post a bond that is slashed if its work fails audit, so a thousand fake agents mean a thousand forfeitable stakes. An attacker pays per identity, and the loss scales with each one: one wallet funds them all, and a single slashed forge attempt drains the pool behind every alias. Cheap clones can never be cheaper than the capital they must risk, so identity stops being a relic of trust and becomes measurable skin in the game. Inflation, a nebula of throwaway keys, adds only cost, never leverage.
